# Test fixtures

`1272-128104-0000.flac` and `1272-128104-0001.flac` are two utterances from the
LibriSpeech ASR corpus (dev-clean split, speaker 1272), read from a public-domain
LibriVox recording. LibriSpeech is distributed under the Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0):

> V. Panayotov, G. Chen, D. Povey and S. Khudanpur, "LibriSpeech: an ASR corpus
> based on public domain audio books", ICASSP 2015. https://www.openslr.org/12

Transcripts:

- `1272-128104-0000`: "Mister Quilter is the apostle of the middle classes and we are glad to welcome his gospel"
- `1272-128104-0001`: "Nor is Mister Quilter's manner less interesting than his matter"
